text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the student-led Halloween event 
drawing near, Hishi Akebono was browsing a 
magazine feature on handmade sweets with a 
thoughtful look.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ghost macarons and pumpkin pie... Hmm, 
they all look so delicious, though.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You know, I was asked to be in charge of 
preparing the sweets for the upcoming 
Halloween event~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And so, since we have the chance, I wanna 
make treats that are pa~cked with 
Halloween vibes, but~—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Halloween's all about dressing up, getting 
spooky surprises, excitement, and tons of 
fun, right~~♪?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That's why I don't want my sweets to just 
be tasty, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm so torn~. What kind of 
treat would be Halloween-y, surprising, 
and "marvelous"?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even making it normally would please 
everyone, and yet striving to make it even 
more 'fun' for all is so like her.
choice_data_list:
In that case, why don't we head outside to 
look for ideas?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh? Outside?
choice_data_list:
Because the whole town is full of 
Halloween decorations.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I see~! Maybe looking at Halloween 
decorations will give us a bono hint?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's go, let's go☆ I'm getting so 
excited~!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, Halloween, Halloween♪ Everywhere 
you look, it's pumpkins and ghosts all 
over!
choice_data_list: Now then, where should we start looking?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I guess I'm pretty curious about 
the sweet shop after all. Wonder what kind 
of buono treats they have~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Wooww♪ This pumpkin cake has a ghost face 
on it~~♡

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
But still, but still, when it's this cute, 
it feels like a waste to eat it, doesn't 
it?
choice_data_list:
True. I might hesitate a bit before 
cutting into it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Cute is nice and all, but... what really 
matters is making people go 'Whoa~ I wanna 
eat that!' when they see it. That's buono♪
choice_data_list:
I wonder if there's anything else we can 
use for reference?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, black cat cookies, and 
will-o'-the-wisp candies, and~... Eek!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following her gaze, I saw cookies shaped 
like withered fingers, with almonds 
arranged to look like nails.
choice_data_list: So this is called a "Witch's Finger," huh.
Oh, so this is called a "Witch's Finger"!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That's a classic Halloween thing 
overseas~! I was so surprised, I didn't 
expect to find it here!
choice_data_list:
Something like this is pretty fun once you 
realize it's candy.

Something like this is pretty fun once you 
realize it's candy, right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. But still, it's a little scary, my 
heart might race just trying to eat it~.
choice_data_list:
It's surprising, but is it really what 
you'd call fun?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah! It's Halloween, so doing the whole 
‘Eek, so scary!’ thing is fine, but... if 
it were me, I'd want to make it even more 
exciting!”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I got it! If I'm making something 
for Halloween—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so arrived the day of Halloween. In 
the cafeteria, Hishi Akebono was serving 
up her special sweets.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone! Eat lots and lots of these 
special Halloween sweets☆"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Yakisoba, burgers, and curry... —Wait, 
where are the sweets!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I wonder~? Who knows~♪ Fufu, maybe you'll 
find out once you try the food?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh?? Did my taste buds glitch out!? This 
tastes like cocoa, but...!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~♪ It looks like meat, but it tastes 
like chocolate!? A shocking 
transformation, maaarvelous☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe♪ It looks like regular food, but 
it's definitely sweets~.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Erstaunlich! Such highly precise 
craftsmanship... I imagine it must have 
taken immense effort.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"With a single bite, an unexpectedly 
delicious impact... What a wonderful 
illusion, so fitting for Halloween♪"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
“—What's this!? Is this really a sweet!? 
—Wait, this tastes like pudding!? No 
way~!? —Which one next!? I wanna try them 
all~!!”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪ The Buono prank sweets were a huge 
success☆
choice_data_list: We managed to make it a "fun" surprise!
We managed to make it a "fun" surprise!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Seeing everyone smile makes me feel 
all warm and fuzzy inside too~♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Akebono-chan! Can I post this on 
Umastagram? It's hilarious, and I wanna 
show my besties!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Waaay, thank you! You're totally free to 
give it to them~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Hishi Akebono's sweets were a 
massive hit. And a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa☆ What we're making today is... 
this! Cocoa sponge cake that looks just 
like yakisoba~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Let's make it together and blow someone 
away~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her sweets went viral on social media, 
leading to a plan to make a video tutorial 
on how to bake them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And so, it had turned into a fun 
Halloween event, but...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, Akebono? Looks like the food's 
almost gone... Could this be... no-velous?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah-wah, oh no! I have to hurry and 
make some more~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Hishi Akebono dashed off in a 
hurry.
